about.body: The S68 is BMW M's latest-generation twin-turbocharged V8 petrol engine, introduced in 2022. It's BMW's first-ever standalone M-only model engine since the original M1 in 1978, powering the current XM and the new G90 M5. The S68 is a "nut-and-bolt different" design from the S63 it replaces — a new crankshaft, oil cooler, turbochargers, and the first-ever electric VANOS system in a BMW V8. It's also the first BMW V8 to be fitted with a 48V mild-hybrid system as standard across all applications.

byModel.body: Across the M5, the S68 powers the new G90 generation (2024–present), replacing the previous F90's S63 V8. The XM (G09, 2022–present) is BMW M's standalone performance SUV flagship, using the S68 in both standard and Label Red form — the latter offering increased output from the same engine.

compatibility.body: The S68 is fitted across two distinct applications — the M5 (G90) and the XM (G09) — with mild-hybrid integration, chassis-specific ancillaries, and mounting differences that mean the engine isn't a drop-in match across applications.
